messages:
sara: hey team — ran into a weird onboarding issue with the ruby sample app after pulling v0.8.0 today. `bundle exec ruby sample_app.rb` raises `LoadError: cannot load such file -- redwood` :confused:

alex: ugh. can you paste the exact error and Gemfile/Gemspec? sounds like `require_paths` or `lib` not packaged in the gemspec. :eyes:

sara: error: `LoadError: cannot load such file -- redwood/client`
Gemfile (short):
```
source 'https://rubygems.org'
gem 'redwood', path: '../ruby-client'
```
Gemspec snippet (from local):
```ruby
spec.files = Dir.glob('lib/**/*.rb')
# we use require_paths default, but maybe missing lib/redwood.rb
```

jordan: hmm parity note — our CI builds the gem and pushes a local gem in the sampleapp job. if the gemspec globs miss `lib/redwood.rb` the require will fail. also saw `require_relative` usage in sampleapp that expects top-level `redwood.rb`.

nate: i can repro. CI also failing on windows runner. filing small PR to update gemspec and add a smoke test. will link PR when ready. :+1:

ci-bot: CI Failed — ruby-sampleapp / bundle / windows (job 4221). See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4221

alex: quick fix candidate: ensure `spec.require_paths = ['lib']` and add `lib/redwood.rb` that requires submodules. minimal diff: 
```diff
- spec.files = Dir.glob('lib/**/*.rb')
+ spec.require_paths = ['lib']
+ spec.files = Dir.glob('lib/**/*.rb')
```

sara: that diff looks fine. also noticed auth/retry behavior mismatch with node: when token refresh fails we currently surface 401 to caller instead of attempting the same token-refresh+retry flow as node. not urgent for this thread but worth logging.

jordan: please create two small issues: (1) gemspec packaging + sampleapp smoke, (2) auth/retry parity for token refresh flow. i'll prioritize the auth parity next sprint.

nate: opened PR #456: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-client/pull/456 — adds require_paths + smoke test and fixes the sampleapp require. also added CHANGELOG entry.

sara: thanks! ran the branch locally — sampleapp boots now. :tada:

alex: leaving a quick review on #456. minor nit on test fixture names. once CI green i'll merge.

ci-bot: CI Passed — ruby-client / unit / linux (job 4234).

jordan: awesome. re: auth/retry parity issue, created issue #789 and added reproduction steps and a short patch suggestion. linking in the PR description would be great so we don't lose context.

sara: linking #789 in PR description now. thanks all for quick turnaround. :wave:

nate: merged #456, releasing v0.8.1 now. will monitor slack for any more onboarding fallout.

alex: quick follow-up: add a tiny line in the sampleapp README about `bundle install --local` when testing from local gem. avoids confusion.

sara: adding that as a docs PR after lunch.
